name: robots/jacopopan__gymnasium-docker-ros2
title: GDR2 Docker/ROS 2 point-mass environment
intro: GDR2 Docker/ROS 2 point-mass environment, adapted from jacopopan/gymnasium-docker-ros2. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset` and `seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
